description: Three decay envelopes, each fired by its own trigger and with its own falling curve, drawn together on a small scope

params.text: Sets how long that track's envelope takes to fall, 10ms to 2 seconds
Bends the fall of that track's envelope, 0 to 0.99, and which pair of curves it bends between is chosen per track on the menu
Sets how much time one screen of the scope covers, 5ms at the top of its travel to 50 seconds at the bottom; it carries no marking and is set by dragging up and down over the display
An attenuator on the voltage reaching that track's decay jack, 0% to 100%; it carries no marking and is set by dragging up and down over it

inputs.text: A rising edge through 2V restarts that track's envelope from the beginning
Added to that track's DECAY knob through the attenuator over this jack, 10V covering the knob's whole travel at full attenuation; the total is held between 10ms and 2 seconds

menu: Attack Time — a slider for each track setting how long its envelope takes to rise before the fall begins, 0.5ms to 20ms, starting at 1ms
Shape — a submenu per track choosing what its SHAPE knob bends between: S-Drum, an almost instant collapse to a nearly straight fall, or Extreme Curve, a steep drop to a long tail
Retrigger — makes a trigger arriving part way down the fall rise from the level the envelope had reached rather than from zero
